EditCLIP: Representation Learning for Image Editing
	







  














	
		
	
	
		📚 Introduction
	

The TOP-Bench-X dataset offers Query and Exemplar image pairs tailored for exemplar-based image editing. We built it by adapting the TOP-Bench dataset from InstructBrush (also uploaded huggingface version at Aleksandar/InstructBrush-Bench). Specifically, we use the original training split to generate exemplar images and the test split to supply their corresponding queries.
